race.comment: SNAP DECISION (3) sets the standard after winning a BM66 at Goulburn by two and a half lengths six days ago, with Brodie Loy retaining the ride and a sound 1600m record already in place. The step from country grade to this BM70 is the obvious new test, but his prior nose defeat over 2000m at this track adds depth to the case. SPREAD THE LOVE (5) comes back from Saturday company at Randwick, where he was seventh in a BM78, and his Rosehill third two starts ago reads well after being held up and hampered. Pierre Boudvillain returning is another positive and will relish a rain affected track. THE ADIGE (6) has to come from a BM50 second at Goulburn into stronger company, though the head defeat and weight relief keep him in the mix. Each way contender. RILEYCAT (2) has been freshened since a Warwick Farm miss and is better judged on her Queanbeyan BM74 second and strong record at this track. Well drawn and not to be overlooked. HUSSY LA VISTA (8) drops in trip and not to be overlooked.
